title: Haggai
author: Haggai the prophet.
historicalSetting: Haggai calls the returned people to rebuild the temple and seek God's glory first.
keyVerse: Haggai 2:9 — "The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former."
christFocus: Haggai points to Christ as the true glory of God's house and the One through whom God's presence comes to His people.
